passages.title: Leadership shuffle at Titan: Ajoy Chawla to succeed CK Venkataraman as MD from Jan 2026
passages.text:
In a series of senior-level leadership changes following Ajoy Chawla’s elevation as Managing Director and CEO of Titan Company, Arun Narayan has been named the next CEO of the company’s Jewellery Division. Narayan, who currently heads the Tanishq India business and is responsible for retail, marketing, and merchandising, will assume the new role from January 1, 2026, succeeding Ajoy Chawla.
Narayan, a postgraduate from IIM-Calcutta, is from the Tata Administrative Services (TAS) cadre, and brings nearly three decades of experience with the Tata Group and Titan across retail, marketing, and sales leadership roles. He has led Tanishq India since April 2020, overseeing retail, marketing, and merchandising. Previously, he held key leadership positions, including Regional Business Head (West, all categories), Helios Business Head, and National Sales & Retail Head for Titan Watches.
Additionally, Titan announced that Kuruvilla Markose, currently CEO of the International Business Division, will take over as CEO of the Watches Division from August 13. He will succeed Suparna Mitra, who is stepping down due to personal reasons.

passages.title: Arun Narayan To Succeed Ajoy Chawla as Titan’s Jewellery Division CEO in 2026
passages.text:
Titan Company Limited has announced two major senior leadership transitions as part of its succession planning, effective August 2025 and January 2026. Following earlier disclosures, Ajoy Chawla, CEO of the Jewellery Division, is set to take over as Managing Director of Titan from 1st January 2026. In line with this, Arun Narayan, who currently heads Tanishq India’s Retail, Marketing and Merchandising, will be elevated to CEO of the Jewellery Division from the same date.
Separately, Kuruvilla Markose, currently CEO of Titan’s International Business Division, will succeed Suparna Mitra as CEO of the Watches Division, effective 13th August 2025. Mitra had earlier announced her resignation.
Narayan is an IIM Calcutta alumnus and Tata Administrative Services (TAS) officer with nearly 30 years of experience across various leadership roles in the Tata Group and Titan, including Retail and Sales leadership for Titan Watches and Helios.
Markose, also from the TAS cadre, holds degrees in Agriculture and an MBA from IIFT. He has led Titan’s digital and international business initiatives since 2015, drawing on over three decades of cross-sectoral experience.

passages.text:
Nirakar Chand to lead BullionX™ as IGM strengthens its vision for a technology-driven, integrated bullion market.
India Gold Metaverse (IGM) today announced the appointment of former CEO of Diamond India Ltd., Mr. Nirakar Chand, as the Managing Director of its bullion market vertical, BullionX™, which is a technology-enabled ecosystem for modern bullion markets.
Earlier in his career, Mr. Chand had spent 22 years at State Bank of India (SBI) — 6 years in Bullion and 16 years in Corporate Finance, Investment Banking and general management. After that, and prior to joining IGM, he was CEO for 16 years at Diamond India Ltd., a prominent nominated agency authorised for import and distribution of bullion, which mainly supported over 1,200 small and mid-sized exporters across the country.
With this nearly four decades of experience, Mr. Chand brings a strong understanding of bullion markets and the broader precious metals ecosystem, providing valuable industry insight and strategic vision that will further strengthen IGM’s position in the market.

Nirakar Chand, Managing Director – Bullion Market, IGM, said:
“I am delighted to join IGM, which has laid out an exceptionally visionary and timely blueprint to revolutionise the gold industry through transparency, digital accessibility, and robust institutional infrastructure. I look forward to working closely with the IGM management and our industry partners to unlock the true potential of our bullion markets and build an inclusive, trusted ecosystem that benefits every stakeholder.”
Welcoming him to the leadership team, Lamon Rutten, Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer, IGM, said:
“With his vast experience in the bullion market, Mr. Chand will be an invaluable addition to the IGM executive team. His profound domain expertise, deep-rooted relationships across the bullion industry, and operational mastery will provide tremendous impetus to IGM’s objectives. We look forward to his strategic leadership as we build a transformative, world-class market infrastructure.”

“I am delighted to join IGM, which has laid out an exceptionally visionary and timely blueprint to revolutionise the gold industry through transparency, digital accessibility, and robust institutional infrastructure. Nirakar Chand to lead BullionX™ as IGM strengthens its vision for a technology-driven, integrated bullion market.
India Gold Metaverse (IGM) today announced the appointment of former CEO of Diamond India Ltd., Mr. Nirakar Chand, as the Managing Director of its bullion market vertical, BullionX™, which is a technology-enabled ecosystem for modern bullion markets.
Earlier in his career, Mr. Chand had spent 22 years at State Bank of India (SBI) — 6 years in Bullion and 16 years in Corporate Finance, Investment Banking and general management. After that, and prior to joining IGM, he was CEO for 16 years at Diamond India Ltd., a prominent nominated agency authorised for import and distribution of bullion, which mainly supported over 1,200 small and mid-sized exporters across the country.
With this nearly four decades of experience, Mr. Chand brings a strong understanding of bullion markets and the broader precious metals ecosystem, providing valuable industry insight and strategic vision that will further strengthen IGM’s position in the market.
